# agy stream fixtures
agy-text-run.jsonl is hand-built from the observed shape recorded from agy 1.4.12; content and ids are synthetic.
agy-quota-run.jsonl is a real agy 1.5.1 capture from 2026-11-05 with synthetic ids and text.
No tool step has been recorded yet; the quota capture contains an error_message step.
The AGY_ERROR / 429 quota form is synthetic and tested separately.
The quota-limited capture does not establish successful-stream arrival timing.
